description: Land Title Settlement Department - Nuwara Wewa, Nuwaragam Palatha East D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110190 - File No. 16/0496 - Nuwaragam Palatha East
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and title classifications. The content is focused on land ownership, title settlement, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
